title: Making my weird free idle/auto play Diablo 2 inspired game VELSCOUR has been an exciting experiment over the last 2 weeks.  I was just messing around with Claude Code to see what it could do, and now I've got this game I've spent all my free time making with a small community of players on Reddit.
author: batmessiah
selftext:
Just added a brand new area to the game : The Depth's Edge Caverns.  I started this game 2 weeks ago, expecting it to not work and fizzle out.  Now it's got dozens of different dungeon skins, a dark forest to explore, a giant castle, air ship battles, these new caverns, the Eternal Breach challenge dungeons with crazy dragon fights, tons of QOL updates, cloud saves via Google, nearly 1,000 different unique enemies, 16 fully fleshed out player classes, etc.

This game has eaten all my free time these past 2 weeks, but I'm wanting more people to play it!  The first time I posted the game here, I got a ton of positive feedback.  It's 100% free to play, constantly getting updates, and I respond to posts and bugs pretty quickly over in r/VELSCOUR.  

I'm just posting to make more people aware of my little AI passion project.  I'm using Chat GPT Codex for all the sprite/texture work and Claude Code for all the coding and the three.js modeling.

If you want to try the new Depth's Edge Caverns right away, click on the skull next to the map, and enter "caverns" into the message box and send it to VELSCOUR.  You'll teleport to the entrance immediately.

Also, be sure to find the "auto" play button near the map.  You're going to need it.

[https://agilancer.github.io/velscour/](https://agilancer.github.io/velscour/)
